name: Traffic Control Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Traffic Control Technology Co., Ltd. delivers comprehensive solutions for the rail transit sector. The company's offerings encompass advanced train control systems, including communication-based train control (CBTC), interconnected CBTC variants, and fully automatic operation (FAO) systems. They also develop vehicle-to-vehicle communication-enabled train control, intelligent passenger service platforms, dedicated urban rail transit cloud infrastructure, and smart obstacle detection technologies for railway operations. Beyond product development, the firm actively engages in research for urban rail signaling systems, provides specialized services in system integration and general contracting for signaling projects, and offers crucial maintenance and technical assistance. Established in 2009, its headquarters are located in Beijing, China.
